items.title: Russia’s Sberbank to launch crypto trading infrastructure this year
items.author: Cointelegraph by Robert Lakin

metadata.title_en: Sberbank to launch crypto trading infrastructure by December
metadata.detailed_summary_en: Russia's largest bank, Sberbank, announced plans to launch cryptocurrency trading infrastructure by December 1, coinciding with new Russian crypto regulations that will allow crypto use in foreign trade. This move signals growing institutional adoption in Russia and provides a regulated gateway for crypto trading, potentially boosting the crypto ecosystem in the region. Sberbank is the largest bank in Russia, and the infrastructure is to be operational by December 1, 2023, as Russia establishes market rules and permits crypto for foreign trade.
metadata.background_en: Sberbank is Russia's largest state-owned bank, with significant influence in the financial sector. The Russian government has been developing regulations for cryptocurrencies, aiming to integrate them into the economy while maintaining control. This year, Russia passed a law allowing crypto for foreign trade, setting the stage for banks like Sberbank to offer trading services.
metadata.title_zh: 俄罗斯联邦储蓄银行计划在12月前推出加密货币交易基础设施
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 俄罗斯最大的银行俄罗斯联邦储蓄银行宣布计划在12月1日前推出加密货币交易基础设施，这与允许在对外贸易中使用加密货币的新俄罗斯法规同步。 此举标志着俄罗斯机构采用率的提高，并为加密货币交易提供了受监管的渠道，可能促进该地区的加密货币生态系统发展。 俄罗斯联邦储蓄银行是俄罗斯最大的银行，该基础设施计划于2023年12月1日投入运营，届时俄罗斯将制定市场规则并允许加密货币用于对外贸易。
metadata.background_zh: 俄罗斯联邦储蓄银行是俄罗斯最大的国有银行，在金融领域具有重大影响力。俄罗斯政府一直在制定加密货币法规，旨在将其融入经济同时保持控制。今年，俄罗斯通过了一项法律，允许加密货币用于对外贸易，为像俄罗斯联邦储蓄银行这样的银行提供交易服务奠定了基础。
